# Fridica configuration.
#
# Fridica is your Slack presence. One parent agent (you) listens in the channels
# below. Each Slack thread becomes a session, and the parent delegates real work to
# workers. A worker is a Claude Code or Codex session running on one of the
# machines listed here, in one of that machine's workspaces.

[owner]
slack_user = "U000OWNER"          # your Slack member ID (fridica configure --detect fills this in)
profile = ""                      # a few sentences about you and your projects, shown to every agent
# contract = "contract.md"        # agent rules; defaults to contract.md beside this file

[slack]
workspace = "T000TEAM"
channels = ["C000CHANNEL"]
# delegate_channels = ["C000CHANNEL"]   # channels whose members may start worker jobs (default: all)
app_token_env = "SLACK_APP_TOKEN"
user_token_env = "SLACK_USER_TOKEN"
general_messages = true           # consider replying without an @mention (a cheap triage call decides)
cooldown = 60                     # seconds between unsolicited replies in one channel

[parent]
backend = "claude"                # the parent always runs locally with no tools
model = ""                        # "" uses the CLI's default model
triage_model = ""                 # cheaper model for deciding whether to join a conversation
# default_machine = "local"       # where work goes when nobody names a machine (default: the first one)

[limits]
max_wait_replies = 3              # consecutive clarifying questions before the thread pauses
max_delegations_per_turn = 3
max_workers_per_thread = 4
max_jobs = 4                      # worker jobs running at once across all machines
job_timeout = 14400
worker_idle = 1800                # seconds an idle worker process is kept for follow-ups

[policy]                          # defaults for every machine; machines and workspaces override
mode = "write"                    # read-only | write | full
network = ["github.com", "pypi.org", "files.pythonhosted.org"]
# fetch_repos = ["chengcli/snapy", "UCzhangxi/snapy"]   # requires network = [], approvals != auto, no GPU confinement
approvals = "auto"                # auto (the backend's AI reviewer decides) | on-request | untrusted | never
approval_timeout = 1800
auto_approve = []                 # command prefixes approved without asking, e.g. ["pytest", "git status"]

[machines.local]
transport = "local"
backends = ["claude", "codex"]
# max_workers = 4                 # live worker processes on this machine (default 4)
# max_jobs = 2                    # jobs running at the same time (default 2); each slot gets its share of the GPUs

[machines.local.workspaces]
project = "__ROOT__/project"             # an existing directory; each job slot works in project/worker1, worker2, …

# [machines.snowy]
# transport = "ssh"
# host = "snowy"                  # an alias from ~/.ssh/config; run `ssh snowy` once first
# tags = ["cuda", "rtx5090"]
# backends = ["codex", "claude"]
# max_workers = 3
# max_jobs = 2
# resources = { cpus = 32, gpus = [0], gpu_type = "RTX 5090", memory_gb = 128 }   # declaring gpus turns on gpu_confine
#
# [machines.snowy.workspaces]
# exocubed = "~/scix/repos/exocubed"
# scratch = { path = "/data/scratch", policy = { mode = "full" } }
# canoe = { path = "~/repos/canoe", subfolders = false }   # a single checkout: jobs share it, no worker1/worker2

# [machines.dart9]
# transport = "ssh"
# host = "dart9"
# tags = ["cuda", "gcc"]
# backends = ["codex"]
#
# [machines.dart9.workspaces]
# canoe = "~/repos/canoe"

# [machines.greatlakes]          # Slurm support is not implemented yet; doctor reports it as such
# transport = "slurm"
# host = "greatlakes"             # login host
# tags = ["a100", "multi_gpu"]
# backends = ["codex"]
# slurm = { account = "myaccount", partition = "gpu", gres = "gpu:1", time = "04:00:00" }
#
# [machines.greatlakes.workspaces]
# scratch = "/scratch/myaccount/me"

[github]
enabled = true                    # show the parent the state of linked GitHub pull requests and issues
token_env = "FRIDICA_GITHUB_TOKEN" # optional read-only token; unset means anonymous (60 requests/hour)
cache_seconds = 180

[state]
path = "__ROOT__/state.sqlite3"
